name: Drowned Gull cellar trapdoor lock
notes: The cellar door under the Drowned Gull, the trapdoor to the Undertow (mw-e40.1, route is mw-e40.6 and mw-e40.12): locked until Nell Gannet opens it or the thief finds the trap (fact world.undertow.trapdoor-found). Tier 2, cannot be picked.
hint: A trapdoor under the bar. Nell has the key.
